programme.title: Love's Everlasting Courage
programme.desc: Farmer Clark Davis struggles to repay a loan and save his land during a drought. Making matters worse, his wife becomes gravely ill after agreeing to take a job in order to bring in more income.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Love's Enduring Promise
programme.desc: In this Janette Oke sequel to "Love Comes Softly," the eldest child in an 1800s frontier family, Missie Davis is a bright and beautiful elementary schoolteacher whose love for the prairie is matched only by her passion for books. When Missie encounters Grant, a handsome New England railroad executive, she feels as though shes met a hero from one of her novels.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. She finds a new home, and finds a new teaching position that she settles right into, but Missie has lost all faith in herself, until a chance encounter at her father's church where she adopts homeless orphan Belinda Marshall.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: The sixth installment of the "Love Comes Softly" series follows the now-grown Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) as she struggles to choose between her career aspirations as a doctor and her feelings for a New York lawyer who wants a traditional wife. Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Love Takes Wing
programme.desc: A young doctor (Sarah Jones) moves to a town where a strange illness has stricken several residents, particularly those in the local orphanage. Despite their peril, the townspeople resist her efforts to help because she's a woman, so the doctor must find a way to save the town before it's too late. Haylie Duff, Cloris Leachman, Patrick Duffy. Directed by Lou Diamond Phillips, who also stars. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: Love Finds a Home
programme.desc: Dr. Belinda Owens (Sarah Jones) cares for her pregnant friend, whose opinionated mother-in-law (Patty Duke) resists Belinda's scientific approach to medicine. Adding to Belinda's worries is her own desire, but seeming inability, to become pregnant. Haylie Duff and Jordan Bridges also star. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: Groomzilla
programme.desc: A newly engaged woman makes a wish that her fiancé takes the planning of their wedding seriously, and to her surprise and dismay, her wish comes true.

programme.title: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Romance develops when a cynical divorce mediator has to take care of a client's dog.

programme.title: Backyard Wedding
programme.desc: A med-school graduate (Alicia Witt) returns to her childhood home to plan her backyard wedding. Her ex-husband and former neighbor(Teddy Sears) is also in town, and his presence forces her to reevaluate how strong her current relationship truly is just days before the wedding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Tale of a widower (James Earl Jones) who's determined to make a reading room available in the tough inner-city neighborhood where he and his wife grew up. Joanna Cassidy, Tim Reid, Georg Stanford Brown (who also directed).

programme.title: Love on the Vines
programme.desc: A young lawyer works for six weeks at a vineyard to inherit it.

programme.title: Ice Dreams
programme.desc: An ex-Olympian (Jessica Cauffiel), who abandoned her figure-skating career following a tragic accident, reluctantly begins coaching an aspiring skater (Noelle Bruno). But their local practice rink could soon shut its doors for good as the new owner (Brady Smith) struggles to make ends meet. Jerry Stiller, Shelley Long and Kathleen Wilhoite also star. Directed by David Burton Morris.

programme.desc: A book editor embarks on a fresh start in work and romance after relocating to Los Angeles, where she learns about not judging a book by its cover after meeting two intriguing men: a surfer and a lawyer.

programme.title: Falling in Love with the Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Mark Lucas and Theresa Connolly fall in love but their overbearing mothers ruin their wedding plans and possibly their future together.

programme.desc: Botched directions lead a struggling couple (Teri Polo, Jason Priestley) to a small Mexican town whose residents have a positive effect on the pair's faltering marriage. Cheech Marin and Rebeka Montoya also star. Directed by Steve Gomer.

programme.desc: An artist and single mother (Dana Delany) returns to her childhood home town for Thanksgiving to reconcile with her mother (Doris Roberts), who suffers from Alzheimer's.

programme.desc: A woman who feels nostalgic about her college sorority days takes a job as a house mother to her former chapter. Along with bringing out the best in the girls, she helps to turn the chapter around with the help of the charming Dean of Student Affairs.

programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: Amiable family farce centers around the put-upon parents (John Larroquette, Karen Valentine) of three brides planning simultaneous nuptials. French Stewart, Marina Black. Teri: Jaime Ray Newman. Dahlia: Kelly Overton. Sam: Sebastian Tillinger. Lyle: James Waterston. Jake: Marc Hershon.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: After the Fall
programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. During the recovery process, she befriends a rough-around-the-edges patient (Fiona Dourif) and her neighbor (Rick Malambri), a former rodeo cowboy who encourages her to return to horseback riding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: An ad exec whose boutique agency was swallowed up by her powerful father's firm, begrudgingly becomes attracted to the office rival she's force to work with on an important account.

programme.title: The Right Girl
programme.desc: A spoiled rich girl loses her fortune and is forced to take a job in the real world, where the developing relationship with her new boss and his young son opens her eyes to what money can't buy.

programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: An ad exec whose boutique agency was swallowed up by her powerful father's firm, begrudgingly becomes attracted to the office rival she's force to work with on an important account.

programme.title: Always and Forever
programme.desc: Former high-school sweethearts Grace and Michael (Rena Sofer and Dean McDermott) reconnect at their 20-year high-school reunion. Sparks fly, but the pair are hesitant to jump into a relationship that already failed once. Grace's mom (Barbara Eden), meanwhile, is quick to offer her two cents on her daughter's romantic woes. Max Gail and Rob Boltin also star. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Tale of a widower (James Earl Jones) who's determined to make a reading room available in the tough inner-city neighborhood where he and his wife grew up. Joanna Cassidy, Tim Reid, Georg Stanford Brown (who also directed).

programme.title: Mr. Write
programme.desc: When editor Dori meets her idol, romantic novelist Michael, she's crushed to learn he doesn't really believe in true love. But when Dori's own romance falls apart, only Michael can pick up the pieces and renew her belief in love and in him.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Peter Dobson plays Callie's love interest and fellow transplant recipient, but it's Thomas Kopache who steals the show as her perennially grieving widowed father. Andy Wolk directed.

programme.title: The Yearling
programme.desc: A sensitive teenager grows up with a pet fawn in the Florida wilderness in the 1930s.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: A man and a woman agree to meet after hitting it off on a phone call, but they keep missing each other for various reasons.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: Don't Breathe
programme.desc: Three trapped thieves (Jane Levy, Dylan Minnette, Daniel Zovatto) must fight for their lives after breaking into the home of a blind veteran (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Don't Breathe 2
programme.desc: Blind veteran Norman Nordstrom has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin with a young girl. When a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her, he's forced to tap into even darker and more creative instincts in an effort to save her.

programme.title: The Best Man
programme.desc: A writer (Taye Diggs) heads to New York to be best man at a friend's (Morris Chestnut) wedding, where he meets up with an old flame (Nia Long).

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: Banned from the NBA, a basketball player (Miguel A. Núñez Jr.) dresses in drag in order to play in a woman's league.

programme.title: Five Nights at Freddy's
programme.desc: A troubled security guard begins working at Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. While spending his first night on the job, he realizes the late shift at Freddy's won't be so easy to make it through.

programme.title: Jacob's Ladder
programme.desc: After losing his brother in combat, Jacob Singer returns home from Afghanistan -- only to be pulled into a mind-twisting state of paranoia. Singer soon realizes that his sibling is alive but life is not what it seems.

programme.title: Mirror Mirror
programme.desc: Saved from death by a band of diminutive highway robbers, an exiled princess (Lily Collins) vows to win back her kingdom from an evil queen (Julia Roberts).

programme.title: Not Another Church Movie
programme.desc: Taylor Pherry is given a mission from God to tell his family's stories and inspire his community, what he doesn't know is that the devil has plans of his own.

programme.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World
programme.desc: With an asteroid due to smash into Earth in 21 days, two misfits (Steve Carell, Keira Knightley) embark on a road trip to find one's high-school sweetheart before it's too late.

programme.title: Never Let Go
programme.desc: When an unspeakable evil takes over the world, the only protection for a mother and her twin sons is their house and strong bond. Needing to stay connected at all times, they tether themselves with ropes, clinging to one another and never letting go.

programme.title: It Could Happen to You
programme.desc: A New York policeman (Nicolas Cage) keeps his promise to split a $4 million lottery prize with a waitress (Bridget Fonda), but his wife objects.

programme.title: Elizabeth
